globalSearchDockTitle: Search like VScode Global Search & Replace
settingPanelHotkeyDesc: Use SiYuan command hotkey format, for example Ctrl+F11.
settingReplaceHotkeyDesc: Used to open the panel with the replace row visible, for example Ctrl+F12.
hotkeyConflict: Hotkey {0} conflicts with an existing hotkey: {1}
hotkeyInputPlaceholder: Click here and press a shortcut
settingDefaultReplaceVisibleDesc: When opening from the find entry, show the replace row by default.
settingRememberPositionDesc: Save the dragged panel position and restore it next time.
settingMinimapDesc: Show the document minimap beside the panel while searching.
settingPreloadSelectionDesc: When opening the panel, fill the search box with the current editor selection if any.
settingSearchOnEnterDesc: Only trigger search after pressing Enter instead of searching in real time, reducing lag in large documents.
settingIncludeCodeBlockDesc: Include code blocks in the current document when computing search and replace matches.
settingOptimizeLargeCodeBlocksDesc: When a code block exceeds the configured line threshold, keep search results and current-match navigation, but skip full text highlighting for better responsiveness.
settingLargeCodeBlockLineThresholdDesc: Line count threshold for large code block optimization. Code blocks at or above this size will use the optimized highlight mode.
settingSearchAttributeViewDesc: Include database block content from the current document in search results. Search, highlight, and navigation only; replacement is not supported.
settingSearchHighlightColorDesc: Configure the base highlight color used for text, block-level, and database-cell search matches.
settingDebugLogDesc: Print extra search and replace diagnostics to the console when enabled.
selectionOnly: Find and replace within selection only
replaceCurrentUnsupported: The current match spans complex formatting and cannot be replaced directly yet.
replaceAttributeViewUnsupported: Database results support search, highlight, and navigation only. Replacement is not supported.
replaceCanvasNoteUnsupported: Canvas note nodes support search, highlight, and navigation only. Replacement is not supported.
replaceTerminalUnsupported: Terminal output is read-only and cannot be replaced.
replaceAllConfirm: Replace {count} matches in the current document?
searchPending: Searching and counting matches. Please wait.
navigationPending: Locating the current match. Content is still loading and the panel will scroll to it automatically.
selectionOnlyNoScope: Selection-only mode is enabled, but there is no active selection
regexHelpNote: Regex search is supported. Replacement text is still inserted literally, so backreferences like $1 and \1 are not supported yet.
regexHelpPopoverNote: Supports standard JavaScript RegExp. Click any example below to fill into the search box:
regexHelpDescAny: Matches bracketed text and any content inside (non-greedy)
regexHelpDescWhitespace: matches install and plugin with whitespace between them
extractLimitWarning: Extraction limit reached. Only the first {0} blocks were extracted.
extractFailed: Failed to extract block content. Please try again later.
settingExtractAsBlockRefDesc: Format extracted results as a list of dynamic block references rather than plain text.
searchHelpNote: Supports multi-keyword logical search. Click any example below to fill into the search box:
searchHelpDescAnd: Contains all terms (exact-block first, cross-block second)
searchHelpDescPhrase: Exact phrase match (keeps spaces, no word splitting)
searchHelpDescExclude: Exclude items containing this term (NOT logic)
searchHelpDescOr: Matches either term (uppercase OR or pipe |)
searchHelpDescFilter: Combine with tags, block types, and path filters
globalDockHistoryBtn: Replace history & rollback (opens in split tab)
globalDockSearchPlaceholder: Search vault... (Enter to search, Esc to close)
globalDockEmptyHint: Type keywords and press Enter to search
globalExportEmbedSql: Copy as SiYuan embed SQL block
globalExportCopiedMarkdown: Markdown link list copied to clipboard
globalExportCopiedBlockRefs: Block reference list copied to clipboard
globalExportCopiedEmbedSql: Embed SQL block copied to clipboard
globalHistorySubtitle: (Side-by-side view; click an item to locate it in the editor)
globalHistoryLocateAria: Click to locate this block in the main editor
